_comment: Qubino Flush Shutter: ha fel/le parancs utan nem indul el a motor (0 W, a modul azonnal a celt jelenti, mert elcsuszott a belso pozicioja), a driver az ellenkezo veghelyzetbe kuldi (kalibralas), majd ujrakuldi a celt. Reszletek: qubino_guard.lua.

ops.old:
local function window_shade_level_change(self, device, level, cmd)
  device:send_to_component(SwitchMultilevel:Set({value = level}), cmd.component)
ops.new:
local stb_guard = require "qubino_guard"

local function window_shade_level_change(self, device, level, cmd)
  if cmd.component == "main" then stb_guard.commanded(device, level) end
  device:send_to_component(SwitchMultilevel:Set({value = level}), cmd.component)

[capabilities.windowShade.commands.close.NAME] = close,
      [capabilities.windowShade.commands.pause.NAME] = function(driver, device, cmd)
        stb_guard.cancel(device)
        device:send_to_component(SwitchMultilevel:StopLevelChange({}), cmd.component)
      end
    },
